question: Why is the seed-mantra called the speech-seed in this teaching?
premises: All things come to be through speech.
The seed-mantra is associated with this generative speech.
Its name reflects this causal role.
inference: The seed-mantra is proclaimed as the speech-seed because all comes to be through speech.
plain_english: Indeed all comes to be through speech; therefore it is proclaimed as the speech-seed.
